subject: SolvaTek activation: insurance, W-9, and PO routing
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@solvatek.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SolvaTek activation: insurance, W-9, and PO routing

Hi Marco —

Thanks for the productive kickoff today. To get Procurement to finalize vendor activation and issue a PO we need the standard onboarding docs from your side. Can you send the following by EOD Tuesday?

- Certificate of Insurance (COI) showing Commercial General Liability and Tech E&O limits (per our vendor matrix)
- Filled vendor W-9 (US entity)
- Completed vendor questionnaire (I attached the spreadsheet we use)
- Name and email for AP/Accounts Payable for PO/invoice routing

If you have a COI with an endorsement that names Redwood Inference as an additional insured, please include it. If not, please indicate whether you can provide an endorsement or if you need us to accept a waiver for the endorsement requirement (we'll route for approval).

Attachments: vendor_questionnaire_template.xlsx (please fill and return)

Next steps on our side once we receive the docs:
- Procurement validates coverage and endorsements
- Finance creates vendor record and issues initial PO (net 30 unless otherwise agreed)
- Contracts team will send a purchase order and finalize invoicing address

If anything will be delayed, let me know and we can adjust timing.

Thanks —

Ava Chen
Vendor Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0187

Subject: Re: SolvaTek activation: insurance, W-9, and PO routing

Ava —

Appreciate the clear list. Attached are the COI and W-9. I also filled the vendor questionnaire and included an AP contact.

Quick notes:
- COI attached (SolvaTek_COI.pdf) — our carrier included limits that match your matrix but the endorsement section is blank. We can request an additional insured endorsement; that will likely take 3–5 business days depending on the carrier.
- W-9 attached (SolvaTek_W9.pdf)
- Questionnaire attached (solvatek_vendor_questionnaire.xlsx)
- AP contact: accounts@solvatek.com (AP team)

If Procurement can provisionally issue a PO without the endorsement, we can move forward and provide the endorsement as soon as it's issued. If an endorsement is required before activation, please let me know what specific wording or form your carrier needs and I will escalate.

Thanks,

Marco Ruiz
Director of Business Ops
SolvaTek Inc.

Marcus / Lauren —

Forwarding Marco's response and attachments. COI is in-range but endorsement missing. Marco says endorsement turnaround is 3–5 business days. Can Procurement/Legal accept a provisional PO and approve activation pending receipt of the endorsement? If not, what minimum compensating control do we need to move forward (e.g., shorter payment terms, escrow, or a signed waiver)?

Summary of items received:
- SolvaTek_COI.pdf (limits match matrix; no endorsement)
- SolvaTek_W9.pdf
- solvatek_vendor_questionnaire.xlsx (completed)
- AP contact: accounts@solvatek.com

Proposed options:
1) Issue PO now and mark activation conditional on endorsement within 7 business days.
2) Hold PO until endorsement arrives (will delay start ~1 week).
3) Accept a signed waiver of endorsement and escalate to Legal for approval (if waiver wording acceptable).

Please advise which option you prefer and any specific language needed for the conditional PO. If you want me to open a ticket in Procurement JIRA, I can do that and attach the docs.

Thanks —

Ava Chen
Vendor Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0187
